card.name: Small joins inside institutional and citation text
card.fires_on: Small joining marks and words (such as a colon after a volume number, "the", "as", "and", or "|") inside names of treaties, organizations, funders and journal citations. It fires mostly in general web text about policy, history or academic references.

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A colon after the issue number in a journal reference, just before the page numbers.

modes.label: Linking words in policy text
modes.description: A small word that follows a verb or phrase in talk of treaties, charters, and international bodies.
